_comment: Tamazight (tacawit n Lezzayer, asagna n latin), afrustaq amezwaru: iswiren n unegzum, uslig, asekles, agzul, tifernatin n umiḍan FINCLUDIA. Isekkilen ur nettwasegzi ara ṭṭfen deg tfransist (fallbackLng) — ur d-yettas wara war-asekles ɣer useqdac.

faq.title: Isteqsiyen yettuɣalen

items.question: Anwa aɣawasen n yimiḍanen i yellan?
items.answer: Asestay yesɛa aṭas n yiɣawasen (amsenfaṛ udmawan, taladna meẓẓiyen, tasnulfut meẓẓiyen, akked wiyaḍ ara d-ttwarnun), s tsarut n unekcum amagnu neɣ premium s waɣawas-ik.

items.question: Anta tagara gar umiḍan amagnu d umiḍan premium?
items.answer: Tsarut n umiḍan-ik i d-yettekkan deg ufrinen i izmer ad taweḍ: kra n yimagraden, isegman neɣ ifecka zemren ad ḥerzen i yimiḍanen premium.

items.question: Ablug yeldi i medden war amiḍan?
items.answer: Ih, ablug yeldi i medden. Isegman d ifecka sṭaqen aqqen, u ṭṭfen deg izerfan-ik n unekcum.

items.question: Amek yetteddu uselkim n yisegman?
items.answer: Aselkim yettunefk kan mi ara ttwaḥqeqen akk tsurfatin n useglem n useɣẓef.

items.question: Ufrinen-iw d yisefka-w ḥerzen?
items.answer: Anekcum ɣer yifrinen iḥerzen (tividyutin, tugniwin, isemyazalen) yettwasenqed yal tikkelt. Ulac afus web izemren ad yeḥbes akk tudert n ufrin i d-ttbanen, maca asestay yesnerni s waṭas timmad n uweqqer n uḍfar n usɣunfu.

fin.consentPrivacy: Isefka-k idrimanen weḥd-sen i umiḍan-ik, ur ttwaɣren ara s useqdac-nniḍen war tsentem-ik s wudem ibeyyen. Akkes n umiḍan yesfeḍ isefka-k s wudem yemmedin u ur yettuɣal ara.
fin.consentNoAdvice: FINCLUDIA tessken-d asiḥsab d yiberdan ara tesnadiḍ, maca ur d-tettak ara ameslay n idrimen yettwasbadun ne d laɛahed n uṭaweḍ: yal amḍan isbeyyen tanaḍt-ines d wayen i wumi yebna, sentem akked umahil send yal tadwilt.
fin.consentAccept: Ɣriɣ u qebleɣ sin-a n yiferdisen.
fin.consentRequired: Ilaq ad tqebleḍ sin n yiferdisen ddaw-a send asekles.
fin.footNote: FINCLUDIA tettwabna akka tura: aɣawas-a yessemdiwel yakan turmit i d-ttunefken, maca aṭas n yisebtar i t-yeqqnen ad d-asen s wudem adiwan.
